label: Golden Age of Hindi Cinema
defn: A Hindi studio-era film of the classical Bombay industry (c. 1946 to the early 1970s): song-and-dance melodrama, romance and social drama built around playback songs and stars such as Raj Kapoor, Dilip Kumar, Dev Anand and Nargis, by directors such as Raj Kapoor, Mehboob Khan, Bimal Roy, Vijay Anand, V. Shantaram and Shakti Samanta (Awaara, Shree 420, Devdas, Madhumati, Guide, Pakeezah). Later star masala from c. 1973 goes to A18-1; the art-house strand to A1-6.
